numeric_check_analysis.formula: absolute_error = abs(actual - expected); relative_error = absolute_error / abs(expected); all 797 pairs are finite with nonzero expected operands
numeric_check_analysis.tolerance_authority: Frozen source4ed AuthorCurves.py close_number, check_geometry and snapshot; all original check rows are retained per phase

snapshot_proof_policy.mode: Compact proofs for every completed snapshot plus complete current-run discovery witnesses
snapshot_proof_policy.retained_for_all_100: Full snapshot canonical digest and source record, geometry counts/digest, exact extrusion/body/mass/COM/bounding boxes, full shared tree and relation-validation counts/digests
snapshot_proof_policy.omitted_from_nonwitness_snapshots: Repetitive geometry entity coordinates/IDs and full relation binding arrays remain in immutable raw records whose file hashes and snapshot digests are retained
snapshot_proof_policy.canonical_digest: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False); these are JSON-metadata digests, not native CAD-file hashes
snapshot_proof_policy.reference_format: Recursively replace an object containing only $ref with the object at that JSON pointer; the shared tree and discovery witnesses have no reference cycles
snapshot_proof_policy.full_native_heldout_payloads: Remain external and sealed; neither parsed nor copied for publication

host_supervision.acceptance_scope: research host transport observations only; inspect native batch and controls separately
host_supervision.clock_scope: Host duration uses only the recorded monotonic nanosecond delta; guest epoch timestamps and host UTC timestamps retain their own clock domains

acceptance_limits.dimension_edit_scope: Recorded driving radius/diameter or extrusion-depth edits rebuilt and were measured in the fresh verifier; edits were then closed without saving and source hashes remained unchanged

publication.private_path_replacement: Only private host/guest artifact-root prefixes become <oracle-artifacts>/; raw hashes and portable relative source paths retain provenance
